author: Colin Moriarty
text:
My major analog hobby is gardening; I often spend a couple of hours a day in my yard.

A small selection of this year’s highlights:

-Hibiscus, butterfly bushes, lantana, roses, milkweed around the pool
-Firecrackers amped to be near the mailbox
-Aloha Blues thriving in planters

topReplies.author: Colin Moriarty
topReplies.text:
I also randomly planted a bunch of daisies this year. I’m usually averse, but I couldn’t even tell you why. Maybe too “normal”?

Anyway, I love them now. Dainty little guys.

topReplies.author: reef1017
topReplies.text: Do you do any fruit and vegetable gardening? My wife and I started growing fruits and vegetables 3 years ago and we love it. This morning we were able to fool some raspberries and a couple other items

topReplies.author: Colin Moriarty
topReplies.text:
These look awesome.

I've tried to get some stuff going in years past, but I've never had much luck. My aunt and uncle live on the other side of my neighborhood and grow a ton of veggies, so it's a me problem.

I stick with flowers, bushes, shrubs, trees, etc.

topReplies.author: Glen Seaman
topReplies.text: These are gorgeous! Do you have a favorite flower?

topReplies.author: Colin Moriarty
topReplies.text:
Thank you!

Lily of the Valley is my fav.
